description: Australian Gridded Solar Climatology Web Data Services is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Bureau of Meteorology. These datasets are long term averages of solar radiation at the surface over the Australian land mass. Applications of these data include solar energy, agriculture, building thermal design and water balance modelling. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Bureau of Meteorology. Its tags are Gridded, Meterorology, NEII, National Environment, OpenDAP. It offers 10 resource(s) in html, pdf, spatial viewer, wms, xml. The portal shows 2025-10-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
